entities.summary: Ilimane Diop Gaye is a professional basketball player for Básquet Coruña of the Primera FEB. Although he was born in Senegal, Diop officially represents Spain when being on international duty since he was a baby when his family settled in Spain. Previously, he has led their junior teams to multiple bronze medals.
